company.name: Docucharm
company.shortDescription: Automate paperwork by turning documents into structured data
company.description: Docucharm turns documents into structured data a computer can understand to accurately automate document processing workflows and to take away the need for human data entry. Docucharm’s API can understand various forms of documents (like paystubs, for example) and will extract the necessary information without error.
